scope: Workspace lifecycle source review and bounded audit correlation; no account contents retained in this public summary.

sourceReview.workspaceRegion: From async function loadWorkspaceState through the start of async function getApprovedTab
findings: Extension startup/reload invokes initializeWorkspaceIfChromeFocused, which invokes workspace reconciliation.
Reconciliation can reset an invalid lease or a lease older than 70 minutes to workspace.html. A lease idle longer than 10 minutes is reset only when already on the idle page.
The reconciliation reset uses chrome.tabs.update and keeps the tab ID. It does not contain a tab-removal loop.
The explicit non-workspace tabs.close route is the sole chrome.tabs.remove call in the worker.
Normal tabs.list filters by approved URL patterns, so extension workspace.html pages are omitted from the normal HTTP/HTTPS inventory.
Discovery can adopt group tabs without existing lease records, and reservation selects an unleased group member. Missing prior lease/group state prevents retrospective ownership proof.

writeInterferenceCheck.limitation: No evidence of intervening MCP mutations; page-internal or manual activity cannot be excluded. Shared audit metadata does not identify the caller.

causalLimit: Reload can invoke pre-existing reconciliation. Without prior lease state or removal-event history, a missing tab cannot be attributed to reload or a particular caller.
